scope: Bybit USDT-linear perpetual lifecycle evidence only; no R1 execution or outcome calculation

public_catalog.interpretation: availableSince/availableTo are Tardis recording-availability boundaries, not exchange launch/delisting timestamps. Counts are a discovery index only.

legacy_and_v5_channel_history.lifecycle_information: NOT_PROVEN: the retrieved official connector proves the legacy topic name, not a complete archived USDT-linear field schema or a terminal-state transition.

PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED: official changelog documents ticker-field changes, but this audit found no primary archived field table proving status, launch, delivery, or delist fields for the legacy linear instrument_info payload.

PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED: V5 REST metadata has lifecycle-relevant fields, but it is a current/post-hoc response. Public evidence does not prove Tardis's historical instrument_info label replays a V5 status transition or maps it to a stable historical schema.

lifecycle_fact_assessment.first_existence_or_launch: DERIVABLE_WITH_RULE: first qualified contemporaneous capture gives first observed existence; official launchTime/announcement can upgrade it. It is not a proof of exchange creation absent such evidence.
lifecycle_fact_assessment.tradable_period: DERIVABLE_WITH_RULE: require contemporaneous instrument evidence plus a valid trade or ticker observation; gaps are not tradable.
lifecycle_fact_assessment.suspension_or_interruption: DERIVABLE_WITH_RULE: only an explicit status/event or a classified vendor/exchange incident qualifies. Silence alone is UNKNOWN.
lifecycle_fact_assessment.confirmed_delisting_or_termination: NOT_PROVEN publicly for the full population: requires explicit historical status/delivery field or timestamped official announcement.
lifecycle_fact_assessment.termination_timestamp: NOT_PROVEN from availableTo or last observation; use only an explicit timestamped lifecycle source.
lifecycle_fact_assessment.terminal_price_or_settlement: NOT_PROVEN for a delisted perpetual from trade/ticker disappearance. No synthetic last-price settlement is permitted.
lifecycle_fact_assessment.symbol_reuse_or_relisting: NOT_PROVEN as permanent ticker continuity; default to a new instance whenever observed lifetime or attributes are discontinuous.
lifecycle_fact_assessment.contract_instance_identity: DERIVABLE_WITH_RULE: venue|symbol|contract_type|first_observed, augmented with historical symbolId and attributes if observed; unresolved continuity is a new instance.

graveyard_interpretation: All ten selected solely by catalog recording end had both sampled normalized data types publicly addressable. This positively demonstrates retained historical evidence for later-ended candidates. It does not establish that every availableTo is an exchange delisting, nor that raw instrument_info is retained and semantically sufficient.
source_precedence: qualified contemporaneous raw capture with local timestamp
contradiction_policy: Any high-grade contradiction, or an exposed instrument lacking an explicit terminal execution/settlement fact, is BLOCKED_BY_DATA_INTEGRITY.
